The text does not develop a full evil package around it — it is introduced only as the foil. Proposed assignment: Package 1, with note that it represents the negative/unrectified aspect of the heart-opening domain. The two nodes share the same essential nature (both are aspects of the same divine heart-opening act). If reclassified as bechina, edge 2085 would provide a structural bechina bridge between Package 1 ('נמול לבב אביהם') and Package 2 ('נמול לבבם'), confirming the mirror structure already identified. This reclassification is flagged for review.
